cases.name: Katelin "Kait" Jordyn Crocker
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was an honor graduate of Fairfield Central High School's 2017 class, a violinist, and a talented licensed cosmetologist. She was employed at Ulta in Sandhills as a Beauty Expert, and aspired to be a makeup artist to the stars. Now she is a star herself. She was a joy and light to all she met, Daddy's little Princess, & our obnoxious, hard-headed diva whose heart always led the way."
